scope: V2-06g exact TX prepare software/ARM/native candidate only

Stale/error/known-zero/partial/unknown/TIME paths covered; exact static RAM and conditional stack fit; physical IRQ timing remains outside scope.

Legacy tx_max excludes preparation, now explicitly documented
limitations: No physical 100k/200k acceptance, no WCET or throughput claim
Actual core/wire/queue and runtime admission helper; usable/IRQ callbacks are logical native seams, not an MCU interrupt simulation

Changed legacy tx_max cannot directly compare with S8/S9 TX maxima
Earlier physical failures remain unchanged and open at system level
